physicalNotes: Radius 1.27 Jupiter radii from Gomez et al. 2013 (2013A&A...559A..36G), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2013A%26A...559A..36G/abstract): 90,794.8 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. GM from the mass 1.07 Jupiter masses (Gomez et al. 2013, the mass the NASA Exoplanet Archive's composite table adopts (2013A&A...559A..36G), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive, https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2013A%26A...559A..36G/abstract) times JPL's Jupiter GM. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
